articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: ‘Once the power goes into their hands, they will do anything to use this bill as a weapon to remain in power permanently. We will oppose this bill,’ says Mr. Kharge
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: INDIA bloc leaders on Saturday (November 28, 2026) decided to jointly oppose the Constitution Amendment Bill on delimitation-linked women quota in Parliament, terming the move a bid by the BJP-RSS to permanently remain in power and end democracy in the country. Addressing reporters after the two-hour meeting with floor leaders of Opposition parties, Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge claimed that the Delimitation Bill is against the interests of Scheduled Castes (SC) and the Scheduled Tribes (ST) as they will not get increased seats according to their increased numbers and the bill threatens to "finish democracy". He said Prime Minister Narendra Modi had earlier given the slogan '400-paar' during the last general elections, but by getting this bill passed, he intends to achieve the '800-paar' figure to permanently remain in power and alter the Constitution. "Once the power goes into their hands, they will do anything to use this bill as a weapon to remain in power permanently. We will oppose this bill," Mr. Kharge told reporters. The Congress chief claimed that India will become like China, where they raise hands in thousands to get a majority. "They want to end democracy and give the government in the hands of the BJP/RSS forever. Manusmriti will be implemented, this is certain," he claimed. Mr. Kharge also said that earlier too, the BJP planned to get this bill through, but failed due to the opposition's joint efforts. "They are indulging in this 'natak'. We decided to together oppose this bill, as it is not in favour of SC/ST and they intend to finish democracy in the country," he asserted. The Delimitation Bill was discussed at the meeting of floor leaders of the Opposition, with the clear demands that the current strength of the Lok Sabha should be maintained, women's reservation should be provided based on the current strength of the Lok Sabha and the current allocation of seats among States in the Lok Sabha should be maintained for the next 25 years.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The Opposition leaders met at the Leader of the Opposition's residence here and deliberated on a joint strategy in view of the government's imminent move to reintroduce a Constitutional Amendment Bill in Parliament, involving delimitation.

articles.title: Former High Court judges review arrangements at Thirupparankundram ahead of ‘deepathoon’ lamp lighting
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Temple administrators and the District Collector apprised the judges of the logistical measures currently in place to regulate crowd movement and maintain public order

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The two former Madras High Court judges, Justices S. Vaidyanathan and V. Parthiban, appointed by the Supreme Court as receivers , visited the Sri Subramaniaswamy Temple at Thirupparankundram on Saturday (November 28, 2026), where the top court has ordered the lighting of the lamp on the contested ‘deepathoon’. They assessed the prevailing situation on the ground and reviewed administrative arrangements for the hillock. Following a brief inspection of the temple precincts, the former judges chaired a consultative meeting with the temple priests (bhattars), senior Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) officials, District Collector Nishant Krishna and senior officials of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF). During the closed-door deliberations, the judicial delegation sought detailed briefings from the bhattars regarding traditional rituals and customary practices associated with the shrine and the hilltop. Temple administrators and the District Collector apprised the judges of the logistical measures currently in place to regulate crowd movement and maintain public order. The judges emphasised the need for strict adherence to established legal frameworks while ensuring that routine religious observances continued without disruption. Following the judicial review, personnel from the CRPF formally took over security responsibilities at the foothills and around the contested Deepathoon site. Amidst the developments, a group of devotees and members of Hindu outfits attempted to breach police barricades to ascend the hill towards the Deepathoon pillar. Armed CRPF contingents have since established a multi-tiered security cordon along the trekking paths and entry points leading up the hillock, working in coordination with the local police and district administration. Essential items such as oil, a lamp and other materials were taken to the deepathoon site.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Former High Court judges review arrangements at Thirupparankundram ahead of ‘deepathoon’ lamp lighting

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 03:05:28 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Temple administrators and the District Collector apprised the judges of the logistical measures currently in place to regulate crowd movement and maintain public order

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The two former Madras High Court judges, Justices S. Vaidyanathan and V. Parthiban, appointed by the Supreme Court as receivers , visited the Sri Subramaniaswamy Temple at Thirupparankundram on Saturday (November 28, 2026), where the top court has ordered the lighting of the lamp on the contested ‘deepathoon’. They assessed the prevailing situation on the ground and reviewed administrative arrangements for the hillock. Following a brief inspection of the temple precincts, the former judges chaired a consultative meeting with the temple priests (bhattars), senior Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) officials, District Collector Nishant Krishna and senior officials of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF). During the closed-door deliberations, the judicial delegation sought detailed briefings from the bhattars regarding traditional rituals and customary practices associated with the shrine and the hilltop. Temple administrators and the District Collector apprised the judges of the logistical measures currently in place to regulate crowd movement and maintain public order. The judges emphasised the need for strict adherence to established legal frameworks while ensuring that routine religious observances continued without disruption. Following the judicial review, personnel from the CRPF formally took over security responsibilities at the foothills and around the contested Deepathoon site. Amidst the developments, a group of devotees and members of Hindu outfits attempted to breach police barricades to ascend the hill towards the Deepathoon pillar. Armed CRPF contingents have since established a multi-tiered security cordon along the trekking paths and entry points leading up the hillock, working in coordination with the local police and district administration. Essential items such as oil, a lamp and other materials were taken to the deepathoon site.

articles.title: Sabarimala priest urges pilgrims not to discard clothes in the Pampa
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sabarimala Melsanthi Areekkara Subrahmanyan Sankaran Namboothiri has urged the pilgrims to stop discarding clothes in the Pampa, terming it an “ill custom”.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a statement to media on Saturday, the top priest highlighted the need to preserve the river which is a key part of the Sabarimala pilgrimage. “Everyone is aware of the need to keep the Pampa river clean and hygienic. Unhealthy practices such as discarding clothes in the river must be avoided. The Pampa river is like Mother Ganga. It is revered as Pampa Matha, and the river is associated with the concept of motherhood. It is the duty of every devotee of Lord Ayyappa to keep the river clean,” he said. He urged the pilgrims to strictly follow the instructions issued by the Travancore Devaswom Board and the police, and adhere to the concept treating the hill shrine as Lord Ayyappa’s Poonkavanam or sacred abode. He also requested devotees not to pack plastic articles in their irumudikettu, adding that these were among the most important things pilgrims should keep in mind.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Recently, the authorities had decided to impose an on-the-spot fine of up to ₹5,000 on those found dumping used clothes and waste into the Pampa river during the ongoing Mandala-Makaravilakku season.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Sabarimala priest urges pilgrims not to discard clothes in the Pampa

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 03:02:08 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sabarimala Melsanthi Areekkara Subrahmanyan Sankaran Namboothiri has urged the pilgrims to stop discarding clothes in the Pampa, terming it an “ill custom”.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: In a statement to media on Saturday, the top priest highlighted the need to preserve the river which is a key part of the Sabarimala pilgrimage. “Everyone is aware of the need to keep the Pampa river clean and hygienic. Unhealthy practices such as discarding clothes in the river must be avoided. The Pampa river is like Mother Ganga. It is revered as Pampa Matha, and the river is associated with the concept of motherhood. It is the duty of every devotee of Lord Ayyappa to keep the river clean,” he said. He urged the pilgrims to strictly follow the instructions issued by the Travancore Devaswom Board and the police, and adhere to the concept treating the hill shrine as Lord Ayyappa’s Poonkavanam or sacred abode. He also requested devotees not to pack plastic articles in their irumudikettu, adding that these were among the most important things pilgrims should keep in mind.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Recently, the authorities had decided to impose an on-the-spot fine of up to ₹5,000 on those found dumping used clothes and waste into the Pampa river during the ongoing Mandala-Makaravilakku season.

articles.title: Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosophy a song
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A hundred years after his birth, his songs remain alive not merely because of their unforgettable melodies or the extraordinary resonance of his voice, but because they continue to make us think about humanity, justice, identity, sacrifice and our responsibilities towards one another

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: There are artists whose greatness lies in the beauty they create and there are a rare few whose art enlarges our understanding of life itself. Bharat Ratna Dr Bhupen Hazarika belonged to the latter category. A hundred years after his birth, his songs remain alive not merely because of their unforgettable melodies or the extraordinary resonance of his voice, but because they continue to make us think about humanity, justice, identity, sacrifice and our responsibilities towards one another. To describe Bhupen Da only as a singer would therefore be to diminish the vastness of his personality. He was a composer and lyricist, but also a poet, writer, journalist, filmmaker, scholar and public intellectual. Music, literature and cinema were not separate compartments of his creative life. They were different languages through which he pursued the same questions. What gives dignity to human life? Why does one human being remain indifferent to the suffering of another? What binds people divided by language, region or religion? What is the responsibility of the artist towards society? Bhupen Da possessed the extraordinary gift of transforming such profound questions into songs that everyone could understand. In Manuhe Manuhor Babe, and in its Bengali expression Manush Manusher Jonyo, an entire philosophy of human existence is distilled into one simple proposition: a human being must stand for another human being. There is no elaborate philosophical vocabulary, yet within those few words lies a powerful rejection of caste, creed, prejudice and indifference.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In Bistirno Paroreand later Ganga Behti Ho Kyun, a river becomes more than geography. It becomes a witness to civilisation. The river has seen suffering, inequality and injustice over generations and the poet questions its seemingly indifferent flow. Bhupen Da could take something as familiar as a river and make it the conscience of society. This was the profundity of his art: he could make philosophy sing.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosophy a song

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 03:01:40 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A hundred years after his birth, his songs remain alive not merely because of their unforgettable melodies or the extraordinary resonance of his voice, but because they continue to make us think about humanity, justice, identity, sacrifice and our responsibilities towards one another

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: There are artists whose greatness lies in the beauty they create and there are a rare few whose art enlarges our understanding of life itself. Bharat Ratna Dr Bhupen Hazarika belonged to the latter category. A hundred years after his birth, his songs remain alive not merely because of their unforgettable melodies or the extraordinary resonance of his voice, but because they continue to make us think about humanity, justice, identity, sacrifice and our responsibilities towards one another. To describe Bhupen Da only as a singer would therefore be to diminish the vastness of his personality. He was a composer and lyricist, but also a poet, writer, journalist, filmmaker, scholar and public intellectual. Music, literature and cinema were not separate compartments of his creative life. They were different languages through which he pursued the same questions. What gives dignity to human life? Why does one human being remain indifferent to the suffering of another? What binds people divided by language, region or religion? What is the responsibility of the artist towards society? Bhupen Da possessed the extraordinary gift of transforming such profound questions into songs that everyone could understand. In Manuhe Manuhor Babe, and in its Bengali expression Manush Manusher Jonyo, an entire philosophy of human existence is distilled into one simple proposition: a human being must stand for another human being. There is no elaborate philosophical vocabulary, yet within those few words lies a powerful rejection of caste, creed, prejudice and indifference.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In Bistirno Paroreand later Ganga Behti Ho Kyun, a river becomes more than geography. It becomes a witness to civilisation. The river has seen suffering, inequality and injustice over generations and the poet questions its seemingly indifferent flow. Bhupen Da could take something as familiar as a river and make it the conscience of society. This was the profundity of his art: he could make philosophy sing.

Responsibility (Noun)
ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Philosophical (Adjective)
दार्शनिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Philosophical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Intellectual (Adjective)
बौद्धिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intellectual' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Indifference (Adjective / Verb)
उदासीनता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Indifference' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosophy a song", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. A hundred years after his birth, his songs remain alive not merely because of their unforgettable melodies or the extraordinary resonance of his...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosophy ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosop' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosop' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A hundred years after his birth, his songs remain alive not merely because of their unforgettable melodies or the extraordinary resonance of his..." (Hinglish Arth: उनके जन्म के सौ साल बाद भी, उनके गीत न केवल अपनी अविस्मरणीय धुनों या उनकी आवाज की असाधारण गूंज के कारण जीवित हैं, बल्कि इसलिए कि वे हमें मानवता, न्याय के बारे में सोचने पर मजबूर करते हैं।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Bhupen Hazarika: The voice that gave philosophy a song"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. This was the profundity of his art: he could make philosophy sing.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "This was the profundity of his art: he could make philosophy sing." (Hinglish Arth: यह उनकी कला की गहनता थी: वे दर्शन को गाने पर मजबूर कर सकते थे।)

articles.title: Delimitation Bill LIVE: This Bill is dangerous to democracy, says Kharge; DMK announces support for Centre's proposal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Opposition leaders discuss a joint response ahead of special session; parties warn the move could distort representation, weaken federalism and politically benefit the BJP

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Centre made an oral assurance while introducing the Bill to increase Lok Sabha seats that each State’s share would increase by 50% on a pro-rata basis. However, the increase could weaken the Rajya Sabha’s role as a check on the lower House, while the Lok Sabha’s limited sitting days would leave MPs with less time to raise issues ​ Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051 Centre proposes 25-year freeze on inter-State Lok Sabha seat distribution, plus 50% seat rise and 33% women reservation by 2051. ​ Centre proposes 25-year freeze on inter-State Lok Sabha seat distribution, plus 50% seat rise and 33% women reservation by 2051. A bill listed for introduction in the Lok Sabha makes advance provision for redrawing constituencies in the part of Jammu and Kashmir under Pakistan’s occupation, to take effect once the occupation ends. Section 3(4) of the Delimitation (Second) Bill, 2026 says the Election Commission would act as the Delimitation Commission for the J&K Assembly constituencies in that area “when the area... ceases to be so occupied.” The bill uses the phrase “falling under the occupation of Pakistan” and does not use the term “PoK.” - PTI In Srinagar to attend an event, Union Minister Ramdas Athawale appealed to the the National Conference to support the Bill. “We are bringing a bill to increase seats to 850, with more than 273 seats for women. Earlier in April, our bill failed by 54 votes because Congress and the opposition deliberately tried to fail it. Now we are fully prepared and can get the two-thirds majority,” Mr. Athawale said. “I appeal to Congress, the opposition, and the National Conference to unanimously pass the Delimitation and Women’s Reservation bills. In 2023, everyone supported the Women’s Reservation Bill, so why object to delimitation now? It will create smaller constituencies, increase Lok Sabha and Assembly seats, and give more people a chance,” he said. - PTI

articles.title: RBI cuts daily CRR maintenance to 90%, to unlock over ₹40,000 crore
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest relaxation is expected to improve banks’ liquidity flexibility and support credit deployment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday eased the minimum daily maintenance requirement for the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% to 90%, a move expected to release more than ₹40,000 crore into the banking system and provide banks with additional funds for lending. “On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation and liquidity conditions, it has been decided to reduce the minimum daily maintenance of the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% of the requirement to 90% effective from the fortnight beginning December 1, 2026,” the RBI said. Under the revised arrangement, scheduled banks will be required to maintain at least 90% of their prescribed CRR on each day of the reporting fortnight. However, the average daily CRR maintained during the fortnight must not fall below the level prescribed by the RBI. With the prescribed CRR currently at 3% of a bank’s net demand and time liabilities (NDTL), banks will now have greater flexibility in managing their daily cash balances, while continuing to meet the overall fortnightly requirement. The latest move reverses the tightening introduced on October 9, shortly after the previous Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting. At the time, the RBI had raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement from 90% to 99%, effective from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026. The earlier move came when the banking system was flush with liquidity following substantial mobilisation of funds through foreign currency non-resident (FCNR-B) deposits.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / business (general) / finance (general) / banking / money and monetary policy / Reserve Bank of India

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — नवीनतम छूट से बैंकों की तरलता लचीलेपन में सुधार और ऋण परिनियोजन में सहायता की उम्मीद है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Relaxation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: नियमों में ढील या छूट — किसी कड़े प्रतिबंध को थोड़े समय के लिए हल्का करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Moderation, Easing, Leniency और Antonyms हैं: Strictness, Tightening, Rigidity।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (आरबीआई) ने शुक्रवार को नकद आरक्षित अनुपात (सीआरआर) के लिए न्यूनतम दैनिक रखरखाव की आवश्यकता को 99% से घटाकर 90% कर दिया, इस कदम से बैंकिंग प्रणाली में ₹40,000 करोड़ से अधिक जारी होने और बैंकों को उधार देने के लिए अतिरिक्त धन उपलब्ध होने की उम्मीद है।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — संशोधित व्यवस्था के तहत, अनुसूचित बैंकों को रिपोर्टिंग पखवाड़े के प्रत्येक दिन अपने निर्धारित सीआरआर का कम से कम 90% बनाए रखना आवश्यक होगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, the average daily CRR maintained during the fortnight must not fall below the level prescribed by the RBI.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — वर्तमान में बैंक की शुद्ध मांग और समय देनदारियों (एनडीटीएल) के 3% पर निर्धारित सीआरआर के साथ, बैंकों के पास अब समग्र पाक्षिक आवश्यकता को पूरा करने के साथ-साथ अपने दैनिक नकदी शेष को प्रबंधित करने में अधिक लचीलापन होगा।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Flexibility' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Flexibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #13 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 RBI cuts daily CRR maintenance to 90%, to unlock over ₹40,000 crore

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 09:50:17 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The latest relaxation is expected to improve banks’ liquidity flexibility and support credit deployment.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Friday eased the minimum daily maintenance requirement for the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% to 90%, a move expected to release more than ₹40,000 crore into the banking system and provide banks with additional funds for lending. “On the basis of an assessment of the current and evolving macroeconomic situation and liquidity conditions, it has been decided to reduce the minimum daily maintenance of the cash reserve ratio (CRR) from 99% of the requirement to 90% effective from the fortnight beginning December 1, 2026,” the RBI said. Under the revised arrangement, scheduled banks will be required to maintain at least 90% of their prescribed CRR on each day of the reporting fortnight. However, the average daily CRR maintained during the fortnight must not fall below the level prescribed by the RBI. With the prescribed CRR currently at 3% of a bank’s net demand and time liabilities (NDTL), banks will now have greater flexibility in managing their daily cash balances, while continuing to meet the overall fortnightly requirement. The latest move reverses the tightening introduced on October 9, shortly after the previous Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) meeting. At the time, the RBI had raised the minimum daily CRR maintenance requirement from 90% to 99%, effective from the fortnight beginning October 16, 2026. The earlier move came when the banking system was flush with liquidity following substantial mobilisation of funds through foreign currency non-resident (FCNR-B) deposits.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / business (general) / finance (general) / banking / money and monetary policy / Reserve Bank of India

समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र — पूरे देश की अर्थव्यवस्था (GDP, महंगाई, RBI नीति, रोज़गार) से जुड़ा हुआ।

Mobilisation (Noun)
लामबंदी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Mobilisation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Flexibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Flexibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

articles.title: The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are perpetual in nature and politically hard to reverse, such continuous commitment of financial resources demands prior evaluation and real-time monitoring to address potential shortcomings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Business Standard reported on May 13, 2026 that “Cash-transfer promises have moved from the margins of Indian election manifestos to the centre of political competition, with parties across States promising monthly or one-time payments.” Quoting a PRS Legislative Research report, it further said, “12 States are expected to spend nearly ₹1.68 trillion on unconditional cash-transfer schemes for women in 2025-26, … the outgo is roughly equivalent to 0.5 per cent of India’s GDP, compared with less than 0.2 per cent two years ago.” The RBI report ‘State Finance: Study of State Budgets 2025-26’ reported that the total subsidy outlay increased from ₹1.87 trillion in 2018-19 to ₹4.26 trillion in 2025-26. States often implement promises from their election manifestos soon after forming the government and just before the next election, without any serious assessment of needs or financial commitments. Conception and funding of an infrastructure project are guided by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) that specifies objectives, alternatives considered, financial and economic analysis, risk mitigation, baseline data, and success criteria. A social policy, by contrast, is often the outcome of an electoral promise or based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any comparable ex ante appraisal. Social policies affect human capabilities more directly than infrastructure projects. The scarcity of public resources and their alternative uses make ex ante appraisal of social sector schemes essential. Moreover, social policies are vulnerable to electoral clientelism, and should therefore adhere to the same principles of public expenditure as infrastructure projects — evidence, accountability, equity, efficiency and fiscal responsibility as infrastructure. The claim that the benefits of social policies are not quantifiable should not stop ex ante appraisal, as methodologies exist to overcome this barrier. An ex ante appraisal of a social project leaves an audit trail: the legislature, auditors, the media, and citizens can ask whether the project delivered what it promised. Many social schemes are implemented without the assessment of needs, identification of potential beneficiaries, or adequate funding, and a bureaucratic, top-down, target-chasing approach often replaces a democratic, bottom-up planning and implementation process. This article explores the fiscal and economic fallout of cash transfers and universal subsidies. If politics decides the desired social ends of such schemes, public finance and administration should decide the programme’s funding priority, the quantum of funding and the implementation process required to achieve those ends. Prioritising expenditure is the first step in checking the desirability of public expenditure. For example, the Government of Tamil Nadu allocated nearly ₹1,000 crore in 2026-27 to provide scholarships for girls and boys from Government schools to continue higher education. A recent report in a Tamil Magazine ( Ananda Vikatan , November 18, 2026), based on replies it received to RTI applications, found 7,198 vacancies in permanent teaching positions in Government Arts and Science Colleges. If we include teacher vacancies in professional colleges and universities, the number should be nearly 9,000. Filling these vacancies, delayed for over a decade, would cost ₹1,080 crore per annum, rising every year thereafter. With a huge revenue deficit and fiscal deficit, the State budget lacks the revenue cushion to spend an additional ₹1,080 crore per annum. Prioritising is a normative decision: filling vacancies ensures students learn from regular teachers, whereas funding scholarships alone sends them to colleges without regular teachers. Deciding the quantum of funding and the process of execution requires ex ante evaluation. This should be explicitly oriented toward designing programmes that maximise impact for a given cost, using behavioural models and micro-simulations to predict the effects of hypothetical programmes before implementation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For instance, a universal subsidy scheme is a trade-off between inclusion and exclusion errors. If it is truly universal, the scheme commits the error of including the undeserving and thus reduces the per-capita benefit to people in need. In a target-oriented scheme, it commits the error of excluding the deserving, but it increases the per-capita benefit to people in need. The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बिजनेस स्टैंडर्ड ने 13 मई, 2026 को रिपोर्ट किया कि "नकद-हस्तांतरण के वादे भारतीय चुनाव घोषणापत्रों के हाशिए से हटकर राजनीतिक प्रतिस्पर्धा के केंद्र में आ गए हैं, राज्यों में पार्टियां मासिक या एकमुश्त भुगतान का वादा कर रही हैं।" पीआरएस लेजिस्लेटिव रिसर्च रिपोर्ट का हवाला देते हुए, इसमें आगे कहा गया है, “12 राज्यों को 2025-26 में महिलाओं के लिए बिना शर्त नकद-हस्तांतरण योजनाओं पर लगभग ₹1.68 ट्रिलियन खर्च करने की उम्मीद है, … व्यय लगभग बराबर है।

hinglishTracks.en: The RBI report ‘State Finance: Study of State Budgets 2025-26’ reported that the total subsidy outlay increased from ₹1.87 trillion in 2018-19 to ₹4.26 trillion in 2025-26.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — आरबीआई की रिपोर्ट 'राज्य वित्त: राज्य बजट 2025-26 का अध्ययन' में बताया गया है कि कुल सब्सिडी परिव्यय 2018-19 में ₹1.87 ट्रिलियन से बढ़कर 2025-26 में ₹4.26 ट्रिलियन हो गया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: States often implement promises from their election manifestos soon after forming the government and just before the next election, without any serious assessment of needs or financial commitments.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — राज्य अक्सर सरकार बनने के तुरंत बाद और अगले चुनाव से ठीक पहले, जरूरतों या वित्तीय प्रतिबद्धताओं का कोई गंभीर मूल्यांकन किए बिना, अपने चुनावी घोषणापत्रों के वादों को लागू करते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Conception and funding of an infrastructure project are guided by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) that specifies objectives, alternatives considered, financial and economic analysis, risk mitigation, baseline data, and success criteria.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — एक बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजना की संकल्पना और वित्त पोषण एक विस्तृत परियोजना रिपोर्ट (डीपीआर) द्वारा निर्देशित होती है जो उद्देश्यों, विचार किए गए विकल्पों, वित्तीय और आर्थिक विश्लेषण, जोखिम शमन, आधारभूत डेटा और सफलता मानदंड निर्दिष्ट करती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A social policy, by contrast, is often the outcome of an electoral promise or based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any comparable ex ante appraisal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसके विपरीत, एक सामाजिक नीति अक्सर चुनावी वादे का नतीजा होती है या अपेक्षित चुनावी लाभ पर आधारित होती है, और बिना किसी तुलनीय पूर्व मूल्यांकन के लागू की जाती है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Social policies affect human capabilities more directly than infrastructure projects.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं की तुलना में सामाजिक नीतियां मानवीय क्षमताओं को अधिक सीधे प्रभावित करती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The scarcity of public resources and their alternative uses make ex ante appraisal of social sector schemes essential.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — सार्वजनिक संसाधनों की कमी और उनके वैकल्पिक उपयोग सामाजिक क्षेत्र की योजनाओं का पूर्व-मूल्यांकन आवश्यक बनाते हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Moreover, social policies are vulnerable to electoral clientelism, and should therefore adhere to the same principles of public expenditure as infrastructure projects — evidence, accountability, equity, efficiency and fiscal responsibility as infrastructure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसके अलावा, सामाजिक नीतियां चुनावी ग्राहकवाद के प्रति संवेदनशील हैं, और इसलिए उन्हें बुनियादी ढांचे की परियोजनाओं के रूप में सार्वजनिक व्यय के समान सिद्धांतों का पालन करना चाहिए - बुनियादी ढांचे के रूप में साक्ष्य, जवाबदेही, इक्विटी, दक्षता और राजकोषीय जिम्मेदारी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The claim that the benefits of social policies are not quantifiable should not stop ex ante appraisal, as methodologies exist to overcome this barrier.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यह दावा कि सामाजिक नीतियों के लाभ मात्रात्मक नहीं हैं, पूर्व-मूल्यांकन को नहीं रोकना चाहिए, क्योंकि इस बाधा को दूर करने के लिए पद्धतियां मौजूद हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Quantitative' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: आंकड़ों और संख्या पर आधारित — जिसे ठोस नंबरों और डेटा में मापा जा सके। इसके Synonyms हैं: Measurable, Numerical, Empirical और Antonyms हैं: Qualitative, Subjective, Unmeasurable।

hinglishTracks.en: An ex ante appraisal of a social project leaves an audit trail: the legislature, auditors, the media, and citizens can ask whether the project delivered what it promised.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — किसी सामाजिक परियोजना का पूर्व-मूल्यांकन एक ऑडिट ट्रेल छोड़ता है: विधायिका, लेखा परीक्षक, मीडिया और नागरिक पूछ सकते हैं कि क्या परियोजना ने अपना वादा पूरा किया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Many social schemes are implemented without the assessment of needs, identification of potential beneficiaries, or adequate funding, and a bureaucratic, top-down, target-chasing approach often replaces a democratic, bottom-up planning and implementation process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — कई सामाजिक योजनाएं जरूरतों के मूल्यांकन, संभावित लाभार्थियों की पहचान या पर्याप्त फंडिंग के बिना लागू की जाती हैं, और एक नौकरशाही, ऊपर से नीचे, लक्ष्य का पीछा करने वाला दृष्टिकोण अक्सर लोकतांत्रिक, नीचे से ऊपर की योजना और कार्यान्वयन प्रक्रिया की जगह ले लेता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: This article explores the fiscal and economic fallout of cash transfers and universal subsidies.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह लेख नकद हस्तांतरण और सार्वभौमिक सब्सिडी के राजकोषीय और आर्थिक नतीजों की पड़ताल करता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: If politics decides the desired social ends of such schemes, public finance and administration should decide the programme’s funding priority, the quantum of funding and the implementation process required to achieve those ends.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यदि राजनीति ऐसी योजनाओं के वांछित सामाजिक लक्ष्य तय करती है, तो सार्वजनिक वित्त और प्रशासन को कार्यक्रम की फंडिंग प्राथमिकता, फंडिंग की मात्रा और उन लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए आवश्यक कार्यान्वयन प्रक्रिया तय करनी चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: Prioritising expenditure is the first step in checking the desirability of public expenditure.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — सार्वजनिक व्यय की वांछनीयता की जाँच करने के लिए व्यय को प्राथमिकता देना पहला कदम है।।

hinglishTracks.en: For example, the Government of Tamil Nadu allocated nearly ₹1,000 crore in 2026-27 to provide scholarships for girls and boys from Government schools to continue higher education.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — उदाहरण के लिए, तमिलनाडु सरकार ने सरकारी स्कूलों की लड़कियों और लड़कों को उच्च शिक्षा जारी रखने के लिए छात्रवृत्ति प्रदान करने के लिए 2026-27 में लगभग ₹1,000 करोड़ आवंटित किए।।

hinglishTracks.en: A recent report in a Tamil Magazine ( Ananda Vikatan , November 18, 2026), based on replies it received to RTI applications, found 7,198 vacancies in permanent teaching positions in Government Arts and Science Colleges.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — एक तमिल पत्रिका (आनंद विकटन, 18 नवंबर, 2026) की हालिया रिपोर्ट में, आरटीआई आवेदनों पर प्राप्त उत्तरों के आधार पर, सरकारी कला और विज्ञान महाविद्यालयों में स्थायी शिक्षण पदों पर 7,198 रिक्तियां पाई गईं।।

hinglishTracks.en: If we include teacher vacancies in professional colleges and universities, the number should be nearly 9,000.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यदि हम पेशेवर कॉलेजों और विश्वविद्यालयों में शिक्षक रिक्तियों को शामिल करें, तो संख्या लगभग 9,000 होनी चाहिए।।

hinglishTracks.en: Filling these vacancies, delayed for over a decade, would cost ₹1,080 crore per annum, rising every year thereafter.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — एक दशक से अधिक समय से विलंबित इन रिक्तियों को भरने पर प्रति वर्ष ₹1,080 करोड़ की लागत आएगी, जो उसके बाद हर साल बढ़ती जाएगी।।

hinglishTracks.en: With a huge revenue deficit and fiscal deficit, the State budget lacks the revenue cushion to spend an additional ₹1,080 crore per annum.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — भारी राजस्व घाटे और राजकोषीय घाटे के साथ, राज्य के बजट में प्रति वर्ष अतिरिक्त ₹1,080 करोड़ खर्च करने के लिए राजस्व सहायता का अभाव है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Prioritising is a normative decision: filling vacancies ensures students learn from regular teachers, whereas funding scholarships alone sends them to colleges without regular teachers.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — प्राथमिकता देना एक मानक निर्णय है: रिक्तियों को भरने से यह सुनिश्चित होता है कि छात्र नियमित शिक्षकों से सीखते हैं, जबकि अकेले छात्रवृत्ति के लिए वित्तपोषण उन्हें नियमित शिक्षकों के बिना कॉलेजों में भेजता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Deciding the quantum of funding and the process of execution requires ex ante evaluation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — फंडिंग की मात्रा और निष्पादन की प्रक्रिया तय करने के लिए पूर्व-मूल्यांकन की आवश्यकता होती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: This should be explicitly oriented toward designing programmes that maximise impact for a given cost, using behavioural models and micro-simulations to predict the effects of hypothetical programmes before implementation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — यह स्पष्ट रूप से उन कार्यक्रमों को डिजाइन करने की ओर उन्मुख होना चाहिए जो कार्यान्वयन से पहले काल्पनिक कार्यक्रमों के प्रभावों की भविष्यवाणी करने के लिए व्यवहार मॉडल और सूक्ष्म-सिमुलेशन का उपयोग करके किसी दिए गए लागत के लिए प्रभाव को अधिकतम करते हैं।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Predictably' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably और Antonyms हैं: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly।

hinglishTracks.en: For instance, a universal subsidy scheme is a trade-off between inclusion and exclusion errors.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — उदाहरण के लिए, एक सार्वभौमिक सब्सिडी योजना समावेशन और बहिष्करण त्रुटियों के बीच एक समझौता है।।

hinglishTracks.en: If it is truly universal, the scheme commits the error of including the undeserving and thus reduces the per-capita benefit to people in need.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यदि यह वास्तव में सार्वभौमिक है, तो यह योजना अयोग्य लोगों को शामिल करने की गलती करती है और इस प्रकार जरूरतमंद लोगों को प्रति व्यक्ति लाभ कम कर देती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In a target-oriented scheme, it commits the error of excluding the deserving, but it increases the per-capita benefit to people in need.

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #14 of 30 (27 NOV)

📰 The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes

📌 Published: 27 Nov 2026, 03:34:27 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are perpetual in nature and politically hard to reverse, such continuous commitment of financial resources demands prior evaluation and real-time monitoring to address potential shortcomings

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Business Standard reported on May 13, 2026 that “Cash-transfer promises have moved from the margins of Indian election manifestos to the centre of political competition, with parties across States promising monthly or one-time payments.” Quoting a PRS Legislative Research report, it further said, “12 States are expected to spend nearly ₹1.68 trillion on unconditional cash-transfer schemes for women in 2025-26, … the outgo is roughly equivalent to 0.5 per cent of India’s GDP, compared with less than 0.2 per cent two years ago.” The RBI report ‘State Finance: Study of State Budgets 2025-26’ reported that the total subsidy outlay increased from ₹1.87 trillion in 2018-19 to ₹4.26 trillion in 2025-26. States often implement promises from their election manifestos soon after forming the government and just before the next election, without any serious assessment of needs or financial commitments. Conception and funding of an infrastructure project are guided by a Detailed Project Report (DPR) that specifies objectives, alternatives considered, financial and economic analysis, risk mitigation, baseline data, and success criteria. A social policy, by contrast, is often the outcome of an electoral promise or based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any comparable ex ante appraisal. Social policies affect human capabilities more directly than infrastructure projects. The scarcity of public resources and their alternative uses make ex ante appraisal of social sector schemes essential. Moreover, social policies are vulnerable to electoral clientelism, and should therefore adhere to the same principles of public expenditure as infrastructure projects — evidence, accountability, equity, efficiency and fiscal responsibility as infrastructure. The claim that the benefits of social policies are not quantifiable should not stop ex ante appraisal, as methodologies exist to overcome this barrier. An ex ante appraisal of a social project leaves an audit trail: the legislature, auditors, the media, and citizens can ask whether the project delivered what it promised. Many social schemes are implemented without the assessment of needs, identification of potential beneficiaries, or adequate funding, and a bureaucratic, top-down, target-chasing approach often replaces a democratic, bottom-up planning and implementation process. This article explores the fiscal and economic fallout of cash transfers and universal subsidies. If politics decides the desired social ends of such schemes, public finance and administration should decide the programme’s funding priority, the quantum of funding and the implementation process required to achieve those ends. Prioritising expenditure is the first step in checking the desirability of public expenditure. For example, the Government of Tamil Nadu allocated nearly ₹1,000 crore in 2026-27 to provide scholarships for girls and boys from Government schools to continue higher education. A recent report in a Tamil Magazine ( Ananda Vikatan , November 18, 2026), based on replies it received to RTI applications, found 7,198 vacancies in permanent teaching positions in Government Arts and Science Colleges. If we include teacher vacancies in professional colleges and universities, the number should be nearly 9,000. Filling these vacancies, delayed for over a decade, would cost ₹1,080 crore per annum, rising every year thereafter. With a huge revenue deficit and fiscal deficit, the State budget lacks the revenue cushion to spend an additional ₹1,080 crore per annum. Prioritising is a normative decision: filling vacancies ensures students learn from regular teachers, whereas funding scholarships alone sends them to colleges without regular teachers. Deciding the quantum of funding and the process of execution requires ex ante evaluation. This should be explicitly oriented toward designing programmes that maximise impact for a given cost, using behavioural models and micro-simulations to predict the effects of hypothetical programmes before implementation.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: For instance, a universal subsidy scheme is a trade-off between inclusion and exclusion errors. If it is truly universal, the scheme commits the error of including the undeserving and thus reduces the per-capita benefit to people in need. In a target-oriented scheme, it commits the error of excluding the deserving, but it increases the per-capita benefit to people in need. The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.

A. A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "A social policy is often based on expected electoral gain, and is implemented without any ex ante appraisal; since cash transfers and subsidies are..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "The fiscal cost of cash-transfer schemes"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The choice between the two requires ex ante appraisal of such schemes." (Hinglish Arth: दोनों के बीच चयन के लिए ऐसी योजनाओं के पूर्व मूल्यांकन की आवश्यकता होती है।)

articles.title: Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substantial threat, India should not rush into trade deal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest proposal by the USTR takes the tariff framework on India back to what it was at the start of trade deal negotiations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The new 25% tariffs proposed by the U.S. on India do not pose a substantial risk to Indian exports, and India should go ahead with a trade deal only if it is balanced and reciprocal, according to exporters and trade and tariff experts. An analysis of India’s trade relationship with the U.S. over the last two years showed that the latest tariffs announced by the U.S. have returned the tariff relationship to where it was at the start of trade deal negotiations. The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative on Wednesday proposed a net tariff of 25% on goods imported from India, which could be reduced to 17% if a trade deal is signed by the two countries. The proposed 25% tariff is nearly the same as the 26% tariff U.S. President Donald Trump had originally proposed in his ‘Liberation Day’ reciprocal tariff measure in April 2025. A week later, Mr. Trump paused these tariffs in a bid to secure trade deals with other countries. In July 2025, he announced a 25% tariff on India, the same as what the USTR is now proposing. But Mr. Trump soon announced an additional 25% tariff as a penalty for India’s Russian oil imports taking the total tariff on Indian goods to 50%. During that time, Mr. Trump also announced a 50% tariff on the import of steel and aluminium from all countries. The latest tariffs by the USTR are not in addition to those tariffs, meaning Indian steel and aluminium will continue to attract a 50% duty. In February 2026, India and the U.S. issued a joint statement announcing the framework for an interim deal on trade, under which the U.S. would reduce its tariffs on Indian goods to 18%. This is very close to the 17% the U.S. is proposing now, should a deal be signed, nearly 10 months after the joint statement was issued. As such, the pre-deal, post-deal, and steel and aluminium tariffs by the U.S. on India largely remain where they were at the start of negotiations. Exporters and trade experts have said that India should proceed with a trade deal only if it satisfies Indian interests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “FIEO supports the government’s efforts to conclude the Bilateral Trade Agreement at an early date,” said S.C. Ralhan, president of the Federation of Indian Export Organisations. “The agreement should be balanced and reciprocal, safeguard India’s long-term economic and developmental interests, and ensure that Indian exporters can compete on a level-playing field with suppliers from other countries in the U.S. market.”

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #15 of 30 (26 NOV)

📰 Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substantial threat, India should not rush into trade deal

📌 Published: 26 Nov 2026, 09:13:21 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The latest proposal by the USTR takes the tariff framework on India back to what it was at the start of trade deal negotiations

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The new 25% tariffs proposed by the U.S. on India do not pose a substantial risk to Indian exports, and India should go ahead with a trade deal only if it is balanced and reciprocal, according to exporters and trade and tariff experts. An analysis of India’s trade relationship with the U.S. over the last two years showed that the latest tariffs announced by the U.S. have returned the tariff relationship to where it was at the start of trade deal negotiations. The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative on Wednesday proposed a net tariff of 25% on goods imported from India, which could be reduced to 17% if a trade deal is signed by the two countries. The proposed 25% tariff is nearly the same as the 26% tariff U.S. President Donald Trump had originally proposed in his ‘Liberation Day’ reciprocal tariff measure in April 2025. A week later, Mr. Trump paused these tariffs in a bid to secure trade deals with other countries. In July 2025, he announced a 25% tariff on India, the same as what the USTR is now proposing. But Mr. Trump soon announced an additional 25% tariff as a penalty for India’s Russian oil imports taking the total tariff on Indian goods to 50%. During that time, Mr. Trump also announced a 50% tariff on the import of steel and aluminium from all countries. The latest tariffs by the USTR are not in addition to those tariffs, meaning Indian steel and aluminium will continue to attract a 50% duty. In February 2026, India and the U.S. issued a joint statement announcing the framework for an interim deal on trade, under which the U.S. would reduce its tariffs on Indian goods to 18%. This is very close to the 17% the U.S. is proposing now, should a deal be signed, nearly 10 months after the joint statement was issued. As such, the pre-deal, post-deal, and steel and aluminium tariffs by the U.S. on India largely remain where they were at the start of negotiations. Exporters and trade experts have said that India should proceed with a trade deal only if it satisfies Indian interests.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “FIEO supports the government’s efforts to conclude the Bilateral Trade Agreement at an early date,” said S.C. Ralhan, president of the Federation of Indian Export Organisations. “The agreement should be balanced and reciprocal, safeguard India’s long-term economic and developmental interests, and ensure that Indian exporters can compete on a level-playing field with suppliers from other countries in the U.S. market.”

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Bilateral (Adjective)
द्विपक्षीय — दो देशों के बीच आपसी समझौता, व्यापार या कूटनीतिक बातचीत।
✓ Syn: Reciprocal, Two-sided, Mutual  |  ✖ Ant: Unilateral, Multilateral, One-way
Representative (Adjective)
प्रतिनिधि — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Representative' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Developmental (Adjective)
विकास संबंधी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Developmental' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Substantial (Adjective)
संतोषजनक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Substantial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substantial threat, India should not rush into trade deal", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The latest proposal by the USTR takes the tariff framework on India back to what it was at the start of trade deal negotiations.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substan' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose subs' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose subs' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The latest proposal by the USTR takes the tariff framework on India back to what it was at the start of trade deal negotiations." (Hinglish Arth: यूएसटीआर का नवीनतम प्रस्ताव भारत पर टैरिफ ढांचे को वापस वही स्थिति में ले जाता है जो व्यापार समझौते की बातचीत की शुरुआत में था)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Experts say new U.S. tariffs do not pose substantial threat, India should not rush into trade deal"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “The agreement should be balanced and reciprocal, safeguard India’s long-term economic and developmental interests, and ensure that Indian exporters...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“The agreement should be balanced and reciprocal, safeguard India’s long-term economic and developmental interests, and ensure that Indian exporters..." (Hinglish Arth: “समझौता संतुलित और पारस्परिक होना चाहिए, भारत के दीर्घकालिक आर्थिक और विकासात्मक हितों की रक्षा करना चाहिए, और यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि भारतीय निर्यातक अन्य देशों के आपूर्तिकर्ताओं के साथ समान स्तर पर प्रतिस्पर्धा कर सकें।”)

articles.title: Broad-based pressure on food prices continues: RBI Bulletin
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: CPI inflation peaked to 6.1 % (y-o-y) in October 2026 from 5.5% in September 2026, slightly above the upper tolerance level of 6%–last observed in October 2024.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: High-frequency data up to November 19 indicate continuing broad-based pressure on food prices, according to the November edition of the RBI Bulletin, released on Wednesday. . Prices of all major cereals and pulses picked up. Edible oil prices recorded a broad-based increase, led by mustard oil, the RBI officials said in the State of the Economy article. 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #16 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Broad-based pressure on food prices continues: RBI Bulletin

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 03:14:28 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: CPI inflation peaked to 6.1 % (y-o-y) in October 2026 from 5.5% in September 2026, slightly above the upper tolerance level of 6%–last observed in October 2024.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: High-frequency data up to November 19 indicate continuing broad-based pressure on food prices, according to the November edition of the RBI Bulletin, released on Wednesday. . Prices of all major cereals and pulses picked up. Edible oil prices recorded a broad-based increase, led by mustard oil, the RBI officials said in the State of the Economy article. Vegetable prices presented a mixed picture, with onion prices rising moderately, tomato prices correcting sharply and potato prices picking up. The Indian basket of crude oil declined to $95 per barrel during November 1-18. “The pressure on prices was primarily driven by ‘food and beverages’,” the officials pointed out. Inflationary pressures were, however, not confined to food. Fuel and core inflation also firmed up, with 11 of the 12 CPI divisions registering sequential increases in October. Within food and beverages, inflation rose across most sub-components, with notable spikes in vegetables, cereals, pulses and oils and fats, reflecting positive month-on-month price momentum. Fuel inflation recorded a relatively moderate uptick. Geographically, inflation increased in both rural and urban areas in October, with food and beverages inflation remaining above 6% in both segments. While most States and Union Territories recorded inflation in the 4-6% range, the number reporting rates above 6% increased. On the external front, geopolitical instability in West Asia continued to weigh on the global economic outlook. Although crude oil prices retreated from their October peaks, the absence of a durable peace kept markets volatile. “Apart from extant geopolitical risks, the recent pullback in AI stocks lends uncertainty to the global financial outlook,” the officials said. Despite the challenging global environment and hawkish monetary policy stances adopted by major central banks, the RBI maintained that India’s domestic growth drivers and macroeconomic fundamentals remained important buffers.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The Indian economy continues to maintain the resilience in economic activities as evident from high-frequency indicators,” they said.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Macroeconomic (Adjective)
समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र — पूरे देश की अर्थव्यवस्था (GDP, महंगाई, RBI नीति, रोज़गार) से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Fiscal-scale, National-economic, Aggregate  |  ✖ Ant: Microeconomic, Individual, Local
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Broad-based pressure on food prices continues: RBI Bulletin", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. CPI inflation peaked to 6.1 % (y-o-y) in October 2026 from 5.5% in September 2026, slightly above the upper tolerance level of 6%–last observed in...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Broad-based pressure on food prices continues: R' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Broad-based pressure on food prices continues' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Broad-based pressure on food prices continues' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "CPI inflation peaked to 6.1 % (y-o-y) in October 2026 from 5.5% in September 2026, slightly above the upper tolerance level of 6%–last observed in..." (Hinglish Arth: सीपीआई मुद्रास्फीति अक्टूबर 2026 में 6.1% (वर्ष-दर-वर्ष) तक पहुंच गई, जो सितंबर 2026 में 5.5% थी, जो 6% के ऊपरी सहनशीलता स्तर से थोड़ा ऊपर है - आखिरी बार अक्टूबर 2024 में देखी गई थी।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Broad-based pressure on food prices continues: RBI Bulletin"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “The Indian economy continues to maintain the resilience in economic activities as evident from high-frequency indicators,” they said.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“The Indian economy continues to maintain the resilience in economic activities as evident from high-frequency indicators,” they said." (Hinglish Arth: उन्होंने कहा, "जैसा कि उच्च-आवृत्ति संकेतकों से स्पष्ट है, भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था ने आर्थिक गतिविधियों में लचीलापन बनाए रखा है।")

articles.title: Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in September 2026, as outflows jumped 40%
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Despite September’s performance, net FDI in the first half of the financial year was more than 20% higher than in the same period last year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Net foreign direct investment (FDI) into India in September 2026 fell to its lowest level in at least 5.5 years, with outflows exceeding inflows by nearly $5 billion, data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) shows. This was driven by a simultaneous slump in gross inflows and a jump in outflows. However, net FDI in the first half of the financial year (April-September 2026) was more than 20% higher than in the same period of the previous year. September’s net FDI figure of -$4.95 billion was the lowest since at least March 2021, the earliest month for which data is accessible. Direct investment refers to the inflows that give the investor substantial control over an asset or means of production, as opposed to portfolio investments, which are typically more in the nature of speculative purchases of minor shareholding. Gross inflows, or the total amount of direct investment entering the country, fell to $5.9 billion in September 2026, 46.6% lower than in August, and 17.6% lower than in September of last year. According to the RBI, around two-thirds of the gross inflows were channelled into manufacturing, communication, and computer services sectors, with Singapore and the U.S. as the major source countries. Total outflows climbed to $10.8 billion in September 2026, nearly 40% higher than in August, and 15% higher than in September last year. Within this, repatriation of profits by foreign companies in India grew to $6.4 billion, nearly 37% higher than in the same month last year, and the highest since at least March 2021. Outward investments made by Indian companies grew to a five-month high of $4.4 billion in September 2026. The RBI says that of the outward investments, manufacturing, and financial, insurance and business services sectors accounted for about four-fifths of the amount that flowed out of India, with The Netherlands, Singapore and the U.S. serving as the major destinations.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / foreign investment / economic indicator

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #17 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in September 2026, as outflows jumped 40%

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 03:14:28 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Despite September’s performance, net FDI in the first half of the financial year was more than 20% higher than in the same period last year

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Net foreign direct investment (FDI) into India in September 2026 fell to its lowest level in at least 5.5 years, with outflows exceeding inflows by nearly $5 billion, data released by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) shows. This was driven by a simultaneous slump in gross inflows and a jump in outflows. However, net FDI in the first half of the financial year (April-September 2026) was more than 20% higher than in the same period of the previous year. September’s net FDI figure of -$4.95 billion was the lowest since at least March 2021, the earliest month for which data is accessible. Direct investment refers to the inflows that give the investor substantial control over an asset or means of production, as opposed to portfolio investments, which are typically more in the nature of speculative purchases of minor shareholding. Gross inflows, or the total amount of direct investment entering the country, fell to $5.9 billion in September 2026, 46.6% lower than in August, and 17.6% lower than in September of last year. According to the RBI, around two-thirds of the gross inflows were channelled into manufacturing, communication, and computer services sectors, with Singapore and the U.S. as the major source countries. Total outflows climbed to $10.8 billion in September 2026, nearly 40% higher than in August, and 15% higher than in September last year. Within this, repatriation of profits by foreign companies in India grew to $6.4 billion, nearly 37% higher than in the same month last year, and the highest since at least March 2021. Outward investments made by Indian companies grew to a five-month high of $4.4 billion in September 2026. The RBI says that of the outward investments, manufacturing, and financial, insurance and business services sectors accounted for about four-fifths of the amount that flowed out of India, with The Netherlands, Singapore and the U.S. serving as the major destinations.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / foreign investment / economic indicator

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

एक साथ — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Simultaneous' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Repatriation (Noun)
देश-प्रत्यावर्तन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Repatriation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 📈 Economic, Banking & Finance passage on "Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in September 2026, as outflows jumped 40%", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Despite September’s performance, net FDI in the first half of the financial year was more than 20% higher than in the same period last year.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in Septem' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in Sep' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in Sep' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Despite September’s performance, net FDI in the first half of the financial year was more than 20% higher than in the same period last year." (Hinglish Arth: सितंबर के प्रदर्शन के बावजूद, वित्तीय वर्ष की पहली छमाही में शुद्ध एफडीआई पिछले वर्ष की समान अवधि की तुलना में 20% अधिक था)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Net FDI fell to more than 5.5-year low in September 2026, as outflows jumped 40%"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. economy (general) / foreign investment / economic indicator.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "economy (general) / foreign investment / economic indicator." (Hinglish Arth: अर्थव्यवस्था (सामान्य)/विदेशी निवेश/आर्थिक संकेतक)

articles.title: Duty-free raw sugar imports up to 10 lakh tonnes allowed till March 2027
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The industry expects more imports in the coming days and this will ensure supply of adequate quantity of sugar in the domestic market throughout the sugar season.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Duty-free imports of up to 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar will be permitted until the end of March 2027, according to a notification issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) on Wednesday. A notification issued on August 20 had allowed duty-free imports of up to 10 lakh tonnes of sugar under the Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ) scheme until December 31, 2026. Separately, the DGFT has allowed sugar mills time until September 30, 2027, to process the imported raw sugar and sell it in the domestic market. The Indian Sugar and Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association Director General Deepak Ballani told The Hindu that price parity had prevailed over the past, making it viable for Indian importers to source raw sugar from international markets, primarily Brazil. Some imports have already begun. The industry expects more imports in the coming days and this will ensure supply of adequate quantity of sugar in the domestic market throughout the sugar season. It will also keep the prices stable, he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Agriculture / imports / food / economy (general) / agriculture / farms / consumer goods

📈 Economic, Banking & Finance Paragraph #18 of 30 (28 NOV)

📰 Duty-free raw sugar imports up to 10 lakh tonnes allowed till March 2027

📌 Published: 28 Nov 2026, 03:14:28 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The industry expects more imports in the coming days and this will ensure supply of adequate quantity of sugar in the domestic market throughout the sugar season.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Duty-free imports of up to 10 lakh tonnes of raw sugar will be permitted until the end of March 2027, according to a notification issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) on Wednesday. A notification issued on August 20 had allowed duty-free imports of up to 10 lakh tonnes of sugar under the Tariff Rate Quota (TRQ) scheme until December 31, 2026. Separately, the DGFT has allowed sugar mills time until September 30, 2027, to process the imported raw sugar and sell it in the domestic market. The Indian Sugar and Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association Director General Deepak Ballani told The Hindu that price parity had prevailed over the past, making it viable for Indian importers to source raw sugar from international markets, primarily Brazil. Some imports have already begun. The industry expects more imports in the coming days and this will ensure supply of adequate quantity of sugar in the domestic market throughout the sugar season. It will also keep the prices stable, he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Agriculture / imports / food / economy (general) / agriculture / farms / consumer goods
